meta.name: standard-readme
meta.description: Write or audit README files following the Standard Readme specification (github.com/RichardLitt/standard-readme). Use this skill whenever the user asks to create, write, rewrite, improve, audit, or fix a README - even if they don't mention "standard readme" explicitly. Also trigger when the user says "add a README", "write docs for this repo", "check my README", or anything about README quality or structure.
